narrative.details:
A warrior of the Horde, Regthar Deathgate, is recruiting agents for a mission into the land of Desolace.  Speak with him if you wish to volunteer.  He is stationed in the Barrens, in a series of bunkers west of the Crossroads.

And sharpen your weapons.  Desolace is a place torn by war.
narrative.offerRewardText: Yes, I am recruiting. This mission leads into Desolace, against the centaur there. I will be brief so that you may quickly begin.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 32, 1,300 XP in all.

quests.name: The Kolkar of Desolace
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.
